capabilities: Convert KaTeX to MathJax automatically on paste
Convert KaTeX expressions in the current note
Batch-convert all markdown files in the vault
Wrap matrix/align environments and bare LaTeX tokens as math
extras: Manual installation only (no community plugin store instructions); conversion heuristics like treating plain parentheses or bare LaTeX tokens as math are toggleable and may alter non-math text.
motivation: The author built it to eliminate the hassle of manually fixing math formatting when copying ChatGPT-generated KaTeX content into Obsidian.
problem: Content copied from platforms like ChatGPT uses KaTeX while Obsidian renders MathJax, causing broken math formatting on paste.
summary: Math notation converter that turns KaTeX expressions into MathJax syntax on paste or across notes.
